steps: Use stovetop brewer to extract strong robusta coffee.
Let the concentrate cool slightly before mixing.
Blend cream, condensed milk, and a pinch of salt.
Whip until thick and frothy using the blender.
Pour cooled coffee into a serving glass.
Top with the salted milk foam.

swaps.why: Shop lacks espresso machine; stovetop brewer provides strong robusta base.

hooks: Sweet meets salty in this local twist.
Strong coffee topped with creamy foam.
Try the new salted coffee foam drink.
plan.caption: Ah Seng Drinks Stall is adding Sea Salt Coffee to the menu. We brew strong robusta coffee using our stovetop brewer, then top it with a thick, lightly sweet foam made from cream, condensed milk, and a hint of salt. It’s a smooth, rich sip that balances bitterness with creaminess. Come by and taste the difference. #SeaSaltCoffee #AhSengDrinks
plan.offer: Buy one Sea Salt Coffee, get a free Teh Tarik upgrade.
